en: I bow to the auspicious Goddess, whose brilliance is like that of a thousand rising suns, who blazes with her crown and necklace, whose lips are red as the bimba fruit, who is beautiful with a row of teeth in her smile, adorned with yellow garments,
whose feet are worshipped by Viṣṇu, Brahmā, and Indra, and whose nature is the essence of reality.
I bow perpetually to Mīnākṣī, the ocean of the waters of compassion. ||1||
I bow to the Daughter of the Mountain, who is radiant with a crown shimmering with pearl necklaces and the luster of a full moon face;
who wears tinkling anklets, small bells, and jewels; who shines with the brilliance of a lotus;
and who, accompanied by Vāṇī and Ramā, bestows the fruits of all desires.
I perpetually bow down to Mīnākṣī, the ocean of the waters of compassion. 2.
I bow to Śrīvidyā, who dwells on the left side of Śiva, who blazes with the mantra *hrīṃ*,
who resides in the center of the *bindu* marked by the Śrīcakra, the illustrious leader of the assembly,
the mother of the glorious Ṣaṇmukha, Viṣṇu, and the King, and the auspicious mistress of the universe.
I perpetually prostrate before Mīnākṣī, the ocean of the waters of compassion. ||3||
I bow to the illustrious Sundaranāyikā, the dispeller of fear and bestower of wisdom, who is stainless and dark-hued;
her feet are worshipped by the lotus-seated Brahmā, and she is the younger sister of Nārāyaṇa;
she delights in the sounds of the lute, flute, and drum, and possesses manifold ornaments.
I bow perpetually to Mīnākṣī, the ocean of the waters of compassion. ||4||
I bow to her whose dwelling is in the hearts of various Ṛṣis and lords of sages, who bestows the attainment of various goals,
whose pair of feet is adorned with various flowers, and who is worshipped by Nārāyaṇa;
she who consists of the Brahman of Sound (Nāda), who is higher than the highest, and whose essence is the reality of various meanings.
I perpetually prostrate before Mīnākṣī, the ocean of the waters of compassion. ||5||
